schemaVersion.description: Generator schema version, always the component id.

title.description: Short title for students in plain text.

quantity.description: The scale name as the page writes it, for example pH or magnitude. It occurs in the quote.

factor.description: Per whole step, more than 1 and at most 1000, for example 10 or 32.

factorText.description: The page words for the factor, for example ten times or tenfold. It occurs in the quote and states factor.

effectPhrase.description: What multiplies, in the page words, for example more acidic.

increasing.description: True when a higher scale value means more of the effect; false for pH.

sourceId.description: Id of the source the quote was copied from.

quote.description: Exact characters copied from the source, no ellipsis, 150 characters or fewer. It contains factorText and quantity.

id.description: Lowercase kebab rung id, 40 characters or fewer.

label.description: Rung label in plain text, 1 to 60 characters.

value.description: Scale value stated on the page; it is a whole numeric token in the quote.

sourceId.description: Id of the source the quote was copied from.

quote.description: Exact characters copied from the source, no ellipsis, 150 characters or fewer. It contains the rung value as a whole numeric token.

rungs.description: Page-stated points on the scale, 2 to 8.

id.description: Lowercase kebab case id, 40 characters or fewer.

toValue.description: Ending scale value; must differ from fromValue.
